text: On March 16, 2026, Elis placed a principal amount of 600.0 million of senior unsecured notes under its EMTN (Euro Medium Term Notes) program. [#5430](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5430)

EMTN (Euro Medium Term Notes) On the long-term capital markets, Elis has a 4 billion EMTN program, renewed and approved by the AMF on May 11, 2023, under which it has carried out several bond issues, of which the following are still circulating at December 31, 2025: a bond issue of 550.0 million maturing in April 2028, consisting of:  the second tranche of the bond issue dated October 3, 2019, in the amount of 350.0 million with a maturity of eight and a half years and an annual coupon of 1.625%;  a fully fungible 200.0 million bond issue dated September 23, 2021, forming a single line with the existing bonds maturing in April 2028 (issued on October 3, 2019 for an initial amount of 350 million) with an annual coupon of 1.625%; a bond issue dated May 17, 2022, in the amount of 300.0 million with a maturity of five years and an annual coupon of 4.125%; a bond issue dated March 14, 2024, in the amount of 400.0 million with a maturity of six years and an annual coupon of 3.75%; a bond issue dated September 2, 2025, in the amount of 350.0 million with a maturity of six years and a fixed annual coupon of 3.375%. EMTN (Euro Medium Term Notes) On the long-term capital markets, Elis has a 4.0 billion EMTN program, renewed and approved by the AMF on May 15, 2024, under which it has carried out several bond issues, of which the following are still circulating at December 31, 2025: a tranche issued on October 3, 2019 with a maturity of eight and a half years (maturing in April 2028), in the amount of 350.0 million and an annual coupon of 1.625%; a fully fungible 200.0 million bond issue dated September 23, 2021, forming a single line with the existing bonds maturing in April 2028 issued on October 3, 2019 for an initial amount of 350 million with an annual coupon of 1.625%; a bond issue dated May 17, 2022, for 300.0 million, with a maturity of five years and an annual coupon of 4.125%; a bond issue dated March 21, 2024, for 400.0 million, with a maturity of six years and an annual coupon of 3.75%; a bond issue dated September 2, 2025, for 350.0 million, with a maturity of six years and an annual coupon of 3.375%. In addition, to shore up its liquidity and secure its debt repayment schedule, Elis placed a principal amount of 350.0 million of senior unsecured notes under its EMTN (Euro Medium Term Notes) program at the end of August. [#5993](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5993)

Conditions The main features of the subscription agreement and the Elixir project are: EMTN bond series: 8; EMTN bond tranche: 1; EMTN bond pricing date: August 26, 2025; EMTN bond settlement and delivery date: September 2, 2025 (T+5); EMTN bond maturity date: September 2, 2031; Total principal amount of EMTN bonds: 350,000,000; Par value of EMTN bonds: 100,000; Fixed annual coupon of EMTN bonds: 3.375% per year; Re-offer price of EMTN bonds: 99.925% per year; Re-offer yield of EMTN bonds: 3.389% per year; Gross proceeds from issuance of EMTN bonds: 348,075,000; Underwriting commission: 0.375% (including 60% for the Coordinators and Joint Bookrunners) Reasons given as to why the agreement is beneficial for the Company Within the framework of the EMTN program renewed each year, the objectives of the EMTN bond issuance are to: (i) repay some or all of the amounts due in respect of the Group's existing financing, (ii) meet the Group's general corporate purposes and/or (iii) where applicable, lend and/or make available to its subsidiaries, including M.A.J., the amounts needed to meet their purposes.
